rows.definition: CacheTTLUpgradeReasons is the reason-keyed tally on a gateway usage summary (cmd/fak/serve.go, internal/gatewayusageledger) recording, per cause (volatile_head, no_stable_breakpoint), how many outbound turns skipped or took the 1-hour prompt-cache TTL upgrade.
rows.distinction: The diagnostic why-map behind the TTL-upgrade decision - NOT CacheTTLUpgradesUpgraded (the scalar count of upgrades actually applied) and NOT Config.CacheTTL1H (the lever that arms the upgrade).

rows.definition: CacheTTLUpgradesUpgraded is the scalar counter on the gateway usage summary of how many outbound turns actually had their stable-head cache_control breakpoint upgraded to the 1-hour TTL tier.
rows.distinction: The count of upgrades that FIRED - NOT CacheTTLUpgradeReasons (the keyed why-map explaining each decision) and NOT UpgradeAnthropicStableCacheTTL1h (the rewriter that performs one).

rows.definition: provider_prompt_cache is the cache-value ledger Mechanism label (internal/cachevaluereport, cmd/fak/cachevalue_savings.go) tagging token-equivalent savings the PROVIDER's prompt cache delivered, as opposed to savings fak itself authored.
rows.distinction: The provider-relayed savings MECHANISM tag - NOT ProviderPromptCacheTokenEquiv (the token-equivalent figure carried under that tag) and NOT managed cache (fak guard's own posture over that provider cache).

rows.definition: ProviderPromptCacheTokenEquiv is the aggregated token-equivalent value (internal/cachevaluereport/track2.go) attributed to the provider prompt cache in a Track-2 cache-value rollup period.
rows.distinction: The token-equivalent SAVINGS number - NOT provider_prompt_cache (the mechanism tag it is bucketed under) and NOT FakAuthoredTokenEquiv (the fak-authored share it is summed against).

rows.definition: CompactionBailReasons is the reason-keyed tally on a guard/gateway usage summary (cmd/fak/guard_format.go, internal/gatewayusageledger) counting, per cause (under_budget, prefix_mismatch, too_few_msgs), how many turns DECLINED to compact context.
rows.distinction: The why-map for compaction that DID NOT happen - NOT CompactionShedTokens (tokens compaction actually shed) and NOT CacheTTLUpgradeReasons (the sibling why-map for the TTL-upgrade decision).

rows.definition: CompactionSavedUSD is the dollar value (internal/cachevaluereport/track2.go) of the tokens a compaction event shed, priced at the input per-MTok rate; a positive term in NetUSD = RebateUSD + CompactionSavedUSD - WritePremiumUSD - SpendUSD.
rows.distinction: The DOLLAR value of shed tokens - NOT CompactionShedTokens (the raw token count it is priced from) and NOT RebateUSD (the provider-cache rebate it is summed with).

rows.definition: ContextExtensionTokens is the FleetBenefitReport field (internal/cachevaluereport/fleet_benefit.go) counting how many tokens of effective context window compaction shedding bought back, defaulting to CompactionShedTokens.
rows.distinction: The COUNT of context-window tokens regained - NOT EquivalentContextWindow (the same figure expressed as a fraction of a full window) and NOT ContextBudgetTokens (the window-size denominator).

rows.definition: EquivalentContextWindow is the optional FleetBenefitReport ratio (internal/cachevaluereport/fleet_benefit.go) expressing ContextExtensionTokens as a fraction of a full context window (ContextExtensionTokens / ContextBudgetTokens).
rows.distinction: The extension expressed as WINDOW FRACTIONS - NOT ContextExtensionTokens (the raw token count it derives from) and NOT ContextBudgetTokens (the window-size denominator).

rows.definition: persistGatewayUsageObservation (cmd/fak/serve.go) appends ONE 'exit' row to the gateway-usage ledger at session teardown, capturing the served session's final usage summary including the cache-TTL and compaction tallies.
rows.distinction: The teardown WRITER that emits one ledger exit row - NOT the gateway usage summary struct it serializes, and NOT the compute kernels (matKernel etc.) that share the gateway-engine family.

rows.definition: RenderFleetBenefit (internal/cachevaluereport/fleet_benefit.go) renders the all-time/caller-window FleetBenefitReport aggregate into a compact text section for the cache-value rollup.
rows.distinction: The text RENDERER for the fleet-benefit aggregate - NOT the FleetBenefitReport data it formats, and NOT Materializer/MaterializeLayout (the ctxplan view renderers that share the render-materialize family).

rows.definition: code_slop_scorecard is the batch code-slop scorecard (tools/code_slop_scorecard.py; ported engine in internal/clonescan) that grades duplication and other slop KPIs into a slop_score / slop_debt over the Go corpus.
rows.distinction: The code-SLOP scorecard surface - NOT this concept-disambiguation scorecard (a different scorecard axis entirely) and NOT the agent-readiness scorecard; each owns a distinct debt axis.

rows.definition: Track1Sessions is the FleetBenefitReport counter (internal/cachevaluereport/fleet_benefit.go) of how many Track-1 (provider-cache) sessions contributed to the aggregate cache-value benefit.
rows.distinction: A COUNT of contributing Track-1 sessions - NOT UsageRows (the raw ledger-row count) and NOT DurabilitySession/BatchSession (session TYPES in the session-runtime family).
